exercises.title: Draw request: Maple Run month 8
exercises.intro: Size Maple Run's month-8 draw from percent complete, with the final 10% held back.

buildup.context: Maple Run month 8. The rehab holdback is $100,000. The inspection puts work in place at $90,000. Prior draws total $75,000, and the balance before this draw is $315,000. Lien waivers, the title date-down and insurance are clean, and the loan is in balance (CORE-SVC-05). The final 10% is held until completion (F-RES-18).

lines.label: Cap until completion: 90% of the holdback
Draw: the lower of the two, less prior draws
Interest on the new balance for a 30-day month

exercises.title: In-balance test after the overrun
exercises.intro: Test whether Maple Run is still in balance after the month-7 roof overrun, then run the $12,000 what-if.

buildup.context: Maple Run month 7. Draws to date are $75,000 of the $100,000 holdback. The budget has a $9,000 contingency line. The new roofer costs $8,000 more than the roof line. After that overrun moves to contingency, unpaid budget cost is $25,000. F-RES-25 (SUGGESTED): shortfall = max(0, cost to complete − undrawn holdback).

lines.label: Contingency left after the written reallocation
What-if, $12,000 overrun: cost to complete
lines.hint: Contingency covers only $9,000, so $3,000 is new cost: $25,000 + $3,000.

lines.label: What-if shortfall
lines.hint: max(0, $28,000 − $25,000). Dana Reyes deposits it before any further draw (CORE-SVC-05).

exercises.title: Rate it
exercises.intro: Give each of six loan snapshots a CORE-SVC-07 risk rating from 1 to 5.

items.text: Maple Run month 6: draws on schedule, reports on time.
Maple Run month 7: an $8,000 roof overrun, covered by the $9,000 contingency.
items.why: Performing, but a trigger fired: an overrun covered by contingency (CORE-SVC-07).

items.text: Birchwood month 9: the largest tenant, 21.4% of rent, gives notice, and the cash sweep starts.
items.why: A sweep has started, so the loan is on watch (COM-GEN-12; CORE-SVC-07).

items.text: What-if: Maple Run's month-8 payment arrives 45 days late.
items.why: A payment 30 or more days late is a potential weakness (CORE-SVC-07).

items.text: What-if: a $12,000 roof overrun leaves Maple Run $3,000 out of balance.
items.why: Out of balance is a special-mention example (CORE-SVC-07; F-RES-25).

items.text: What-if: Birchwood month 30. The loan is in default and the exit no longer covers it.
items.why: In default with an exit that no longer covers the loan: a well-defined weakness (CORE-SVC-07).
